name: Cornerstone+
description: Design system for The Great Adpuppytion — Code-Puppy University founding deck. Natural-language prompts map to tokens (tokens.css) and archetype/component classes (theme.css). All edits: change a token or a class, never hardcode.

prompt_guide.recolor an act: Edit the --act-N token in tokens.css §4 (e.g. --act-2: var(--accent-builder))
prompt_guide.change a brand color: Edit a --cp-* primitive in tokens.css §1; semantic layers follow automatically
prompt_guide.change type sizes: Edit --type-* tokens in tokens.css §6; --type-small is the legal body floor
prompt_guide.adjust motion: Edit --motion-* tokens in tokens.css §8; adding a third animated moment violates the motion budget
prompt_guide.add a slide: Pick exactly one archetype (statement/split/stage/ledger), set the act class, obey component_placement rules
prompt_guide.add an image: SPLIT or STAGE slides only, wrapped in .duo for duotone treatment, placehold.co FPO pattern until licensed

statement.purpose: The shout — act breaks, Chaplin beats, closers

rules: two columns: prose left, ONE .artifact right
artifact is quote XOR image, never both

stage.purpose: The artifact IS the slide — timeline, sine wave, terminal, stat wall
rules: eyebrow + .canvas + at most one caption line
one animated moment max per deck act

ledger.purpose: Structured data — the ONLY home of tables/cards
rules: used twice in deck: five-schools table + charter

chaplin.notes: verbatim speech only; .beat spans for gold emphasis

moats.notes: Fireship beat: .then coral / .now mint price ledger

statwall-internal.notes: Act IX/X stat walls: silos, generational divide, franchising

terminal.notes: lines reveal via --d stagger; caret blinks

stackrow.notes: pill + one-liner rows; 3-layer stack + L1–L5 pack ladder

duotone.notes: grayscale + act-color multiply; FPO placehold.co until licensed

logo.notes: Code-Puppy era moment — typographic object, sanctioned .duo exception

locks.chaplin_verbatim: Slides 13–20 + 44 bookend: exact text from docs/jack-conte-sxsw.md, one beat per slide, eyebrows I–VIII
locks.brand_tokens: All color values originate in tokens.css §1; tests enforce theme.css has zero hardcoded hex
locks.type_floor: No reading text below --type-small (0.66em); --type-micro reserved for eyebrows/attributions
locks.factcheck: Slide text must match FACTCHECK.md corrections: 1942 Petrillo ban, Moog 1969, ~20K musicians, Karen X. Cheng, Flanagan 2012, 1992 ASOL/Wolf
locks.single_hue: Within one slide: act color + neutral ink only (rail/charter/act-8 are sanctioned exceptions)
